The prophecy of the chosen begins a movement of selflessness and a search for glory among the people of Terra-Nova. This begins a long period of people becoming adventurers and seeking glory. These heroes shape the course of history and accomplish legendary deeds. Examples: Valerius Stormbringer, Aria Frostwind, Roderick Elroy, etc...
